subject: Renewal paperwork: surge-capacity taper addendum & billing alignment
messages:
From: Leah Chen <leah@cloudarcade.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@cloudarcade.com
Date: Tue, 2 Jan 2029 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: Renewal + surge-capacity ask for next 18 months

Hi Vivek,

Hope your new year is off to a good start. We're preparing our forecast and want to lock an 18‑month renewal that includes a temporary surge buffer for the next two quarters (Q1 and Q2) to cover an expected product launch.

High level: we want to keep the current MSA term but add an addendum that: 
- Adds a 30% burst allowance for Jan–Jun 2029 (metering to be reconciled monthly)
- Includes a taper schedule (30% → 15% → 5%) for Jul–Dec 2029
- Clarifies billing adjustments and overage crediting mechanism

Can your team share a draft addendum we can route to our procurement and legal? We need the paperwork in the week of Jan 8 to stay on track for budgeting.

Thanks — can loop in our contracts if you want a redline directly.

Leah
Leah Chen
Head of Platform Ops, CloudArcade
leah@cloudarcade.com
[Attachment: forecast-Q1Q2-2029.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Leah Chen <leah@cloudarcade.com>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 2 Jan 2029 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal + surge-capacity ask for next 18 months

Leah — appreciate the context and timeline. Monica (cc'd) and I will put together an addendum draft focusing on:

- A surge allowance structure tied to monthly reported usage (so we can reconcile and credit as needed)
- A taper schedule with clear effective dates and how credits/true-ups will flow into the invoice
- A short clause for operational fallbacks (if burst exceeds capacity we route to compatible model variant) — wording to keep app stable

I'll loop Legal early to avoid back-and-forth. Expect v1 by EOD Jan 4; if your contracts want to work on a redline in parallel, please share their preferred format.

Thanks — Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
[Attachment: none]

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: markus_klein@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 4 Jan 2029 09:22:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: Renewal + surge-capacity ask for next 18 months

Vivek / team — drafting guidance from Legal below. Primary redline asks we need to include in the addendum draft: 

1) Precise definition of "surge allowance" (units, measurement window) — we should rely on token-based reporting tied to account invoice IDs and include sample calculation.
2) Cap the maximum monthly surge to a flat % of baseline (e.g., 30%) and add an absolute maximum (so it's bounded).
3) Billing reconciliation: define a 30‑day true-up cycle with crediting approach (credit to next invoice or one-off refund — choose one).
4) Data residency/audit clause: ensure the addendum references the MSA's existing data handling terms (no new data flow obligations).
5) Termination fallback: if Redwood cannot provide surge for a given month due to capacity constraints, include an SLA credit and an agreed fallback model (lower-cost variant) with preserved request routing.

I've attached a Legal markup template we use; please slot the above into the addendum and keep redlineable sections marked. Once we have v1, Legal will push a marked version back for CloudArcade to review.

-Kim
Kimberly Park
Sr. Counsel, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: legal-addendum-template.docx (docx)]

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Leah Chen <leah@cloudarcade.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, markus_klein@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 7 Jan 2029 16:08:00 -08:00
Subject: Draft: Surge Capacity Taper Addendum (v1)

Hi Leah — attached is Redwood's first draft addendum (v1) and a short order form update showing the surge schedule and sample invoice calc. Key items called out at top of doc: 

- Surge measurement: tokens per account per invoice period, reconciled monthly.
- Monthly cap: baseline * 1.3 with absolute cap of 10M tokens / month for the surge period.
- Taper: Jul 1 2029 drop to 15% buffer; Oct 1 2029 drop to 5% buffer; Dec 31 2029 end of taper window.
- Billing: 30-day true-up; credits applied to the following invoice (explicit credit ledger on invoice).
- SLA fallback: if Redwood can't meet surge, we route to a compatible variant defined in Exhibit A; SLA credit equals 10% of that month's surge overage charges.

Action items for your side: please confirm the absolute cap is workable for your launch, and whether CloudArcade prefers credit vs. refund for true-ups. If procurement wants edits, ask them to use tracked changes and send back by Jan 10.

Thanks — Monica
Monica Patel
Customer Success, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: CA_Surge_Addendum_v3.docx (docx); OrderForm_Q1-2029.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Leah Chen <leah@cloudarcade.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: ng-contracts@cloudarcade.com, procurement@cloudarcade.com
Date: Wed, 10 Jan 2029 09:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Draft: Surge Capacity Taper Addendum (v1)

Team — thank you for the quick turnaround. Procurement and our contracts reviewed the draft. A few quick items from our side: 

- Absolute cap looks fine but procurement asks to add a 10% admin buffer on top of the cap for safety (we'll use it only with mutual notice).
- For true-ups, CloudArcade prefers credits applied to the following invoice (simpler for our accounting).
- Contracts will send a marked redline to the same thread by EOD Jan 11; please expect edits in sections 2.1 (measurement) and 3.2 (billing).

If everything aligns after redline, we'll send the final to DocuSign and target signature by Jan 18. Please share the HubSpot deal link + DocuSign envelope once it's ready.

Leah
Leah Chen
Head of Platform Ops, CloudArcade
[Attachment: CA_comments_redline.docx (docx)]
